d:
If you're looking for a proper translation, I'm sorry to say you won't find it here. But in the recent releases, there were some places where the MTL mangling was so egregious that I thought I'd make some changes for my own enjoyment.
Unfortunately, my Japanese isn't proficient enough to translate myself, so translation changes were still DeepL, but I did some typesetting and cleanup.

Basically, I combined these 3 galleries and cleaned up some of the more recent ones.
